balls.text: gone!! SRH are bowled out for 165. Nobody ever said 300 was easy, if I have to borrow a line from The Scientist!! Slower delivery from Tyagi, who bowled it short and outside off. But he still got good carry despite the lack of pace. The ball finished around middle, and Harshal went for the pull. He ended up getting a top edge, and Arora took the skied ball by moving to his left
short in length, and on the stumps. Malinga backs away to punch towards mid-off for a hurried single
good bounce off a length. Tyagi angles it across at 144kph, and bowls on off. The ball shapes away a bit, and Malinga has a jab but misses
shortish in length, and just outside off. Punched to deep point
much quicker from Tyagi. He launches this one at 143kph. It's a short-of-a-length ball around sixth stump, as Harshal looked to slash but missed
between short third and point. Valuable runs for SRH. A slower bouncer from Tyagi, who bowled it wide of off. Harshal rode the bounce, and found the gap with his ramp
a slower short delivery, and left alone. Arora banged it on leg, and got it to end outside off
this ball swings in, and arrives as a low full toss on middle and off. Pushed to long-off
a low full toss arriving around off as Arora bowls a slower one which dips. Driven to long-on
wide outside leg. Arora bowls fullish and outside leg. Malinga looks to flick but misses
a yorker angled across to arrive on sixth stump. Malinga gets a taste of that ball himself. He looks to squeeze it out but misses
shorter side of a length, and angling across to pitch just outside off. Malinga looks to slash but misses

Raghuvanshi is up in appeal, but the umpire calls wide. The KKR keeper checks with his captain... and Rahane reviews. Wow, that's plenty of action in no time. Ohh, there's movement on UltraEdge as the ball passes the glove. So Shivang has to go. The decision is reversed. SRH are sliding and slipping. It was an offcutter from Arora, who banged a bouncer outside off. The ball seamed in to finish on top of leg, and Shivang went for the pull. But he seemed to have played late, as the ball rose sharply

got him?! Oh, Anukul went up in celebration, but the umpire asks him to calm down. Wait, there's some confusion here. Cummins seems to be walking back, but the umpire has referred it to his TV colleague. The first replay shows the ball dipping on to Anukul, with the first impression of the third umpire being of "fingers underneath the ball" as he looks to catch it with both hands. Oh, he says the "ball clearly carried". So Cummins is indeed gone. Anukul always looked convinced. Cummins went slashing at this very full and wide ball outside off, and ended up playing with a flat bat. The ball went flat and low to Anukul, who did well to barely grab it off the pitch
a yorker on the stumps, and jammed back by Cummins to Anukul
wow! Lovely hit. Cummins did that so effortlessly. Shortish delivery wide outside off, and Cummins reaches out to slam it back over long-on
short in length, and just outside off. The ball turns away slightly, and is cut away to deep point
shorter side of a length on middle and leg, and swiped to fine leg
on a length outside off, and punched to cover

one attempt too many from Kishan. He's caught by his Jharkhand team-mate Anukul, who's at long-off. This time Narine floats one much slower and wider of off. The ball is angling across, and dipping on a length outside off. Kishan is down the track again, but this time ends up slicing it high for Anukul to catch. The bat turned in his hands as he lofted it, and that was a sign of where the ball was probably heading
wickets are falling around him, but Kishan decides to counter. He skips down, and bashes this length ball on the stumps over midwicket. Clean hit for six!
length ball on off, and turning in. Punched to long-on
a leave from Cummins. Hmmm, he's missing Tests?! Full, and a little wide of off, and he lets it go
much quicker ball. This is fullish on middle, and is flicked to deep-backward square leg

that's 200 IPL wickets for Narine!! The fact that he gets it with a beautiful ball makes it just perfect. He floats one from the front of the hand, and bowls on a shortish length around off. The ball straightened to beat Arora's push forward, and struck the off stump. Lovely bowling
short delivery a little wide of off. Arora thrashes a pull to deep midwicket
slower bouncer. Tyagi bowls at just 116kph, bangs it on leg, and the ball finishes above Kishan's head on off. He rolls his wrists to pull towards fine leg

on the bounce to point. A centimetre either side, and it could've been four. Shortish in length from Tyagi, and Kishan cuts it from just outside off. There's a wry smile on his face after he missed out
short of a length, and a little wide of off. Guided to deep third
shortish in length, and angling into leg. He looks to clip but is hit on his pad
starts with a short-of-a-length ball on middle. The ball seams away, and is swatted to deep midwicket
slower now. Fuller still, and around sixth stump. Driven to Rahane at cover
quicker ball, and full just outside off. It turns in and beats Arora on the inside edge as he looks to push forward

good catch by Rahane!! It's a no-look slog from Aniket, who has to look and move towards the pavilion now. Rahane was placed at cover, turned halfway to his right, looked up with the sun in his eyes, and kept his concentration. The ball dipped on to him, and completed the take even as he slipped. Varun teased Aniket with a slower ball which dipped on a fullish length around off, and Aniket went heaving with a horizontal bat

a bit of luck goes Aniket's way. Tyagi was at short third, and dived to his left, but the ball was wide of him. Aniket heaved at it almost blindly, but was beaten by this full ball dipping just outside off and turning away
on a fullish length on off, and it straightens. Pushed back with an open stance
well bowled. He angles it in, and gets it to dip on a full length on off. The ball turns in, and is pushed back
Kishan is beaten. He ends up looking awkward there, as the ball is on the shorter side of a length on the stumps, and it seams in to go pas the leg stump. Kishan looked to flick but missed
a fumble from the man at point, but it's still a dot. Short of a length on off, and punched by Kishan
swiped between the keeper and the man at short fine leg. Green bowls this on a length on middle and leg, and Kishan plays through the line to swivel and pull
wide called. A bouncer from Green, as the ball rose just outside the off stump. Kishan looked to play a strange flat-batted swat, and missed
short of a length on middle. He looks to pull, but gets it off his body towards the keeper's right
a whip-pull from Aniket. Short of a length on off, and flung to fine leg
shorter side of a length, and just outside off. He goes back and across, and pushes towards short midwicket
fullish delivery around sixth stump, and turning in and jumping nicely. Punched towards point
full and slower on middle. Driven to long-off
beaten!! He goes driving at this full ball dipping just outside off, but sees the ball go past the inside edge. The ball goes over the off stump, and Raghuvanshi can't collect it as well

gone!! Rahane at cover in action again. Smaran decided to skip down the pitch, but was beaten by the lack of pace as Varun delivered this from back of the hand. Did Smaran really have to attack, though? He advanced down the pitch early, and got a length delivery around sixth stump. He went slicing, but only ended up skying it. Rahane moved to his left to complete the take
much slower, and he gets a leading edge. Full on middle, and the ball pops up towards cover as Smaran looked to clip
very full, and fired at 104kph just outside off. Kishan drills it back, and Varun intercepts the ball with his left ankle. He's a bit hurt, but good to go
pulled to fine leg. Confident start for Smaran. Short ball from Green, as it rises close to Smaran's throat on middle. But he rolls his wrists to pull along the ground
angles it in, and bowls a full ball just outside off. Driven to short cover

stunner from Powell!! This is perhaps the catch of the season. He was at deep midwicket and ran forward, but seemed to have overrun. Realising that, he threw himself nearly behind him with his right hand stretched out like a mit. The ball managed to stick in it even as Powell tumbled and banged his head down on the ground. Even his glasses broke in the process, but the third umpire checks replays multiple times to confirm if it was a clean catch as Powell's hand touched the turf while he fell. He's finally satisfied - Powell already has a new pair of glasses on in the meanwhile - and Klaasen walks back. Klaasen had pulled this bouncer from wide of off, and ended up mistiming it
slower ball, and four. Shorter side of a length on the stumps, and Klaasen whips this to deep square leg. Not entirely well timed, but four still

through Rinku's hands!! One of KKR's best fielders, he was at long-on, and ran to his right. He stretched his hands out, and the ball popped out of them. Klaasen had swung at this length delivery across the line
starts with a length delivery just outside off. Punched to short cover
Full outside off, eased towards long-on
Looks to slap this away but finds short cover
Looks to block and gets an inside edge onto his pads
On a length around middle, blocked back to the bowler
Dropped a bit short and Kishan pulls it out to deep midwicket
Full around leg, blocked back to the bowler

Oh, the Head show is over! He's picked out deep midwicket as he fails to put away this hit-me ball from Varun! KKR's spin maestro bowls a long hop, and will be relived to see Head miscue this one as the ball goes to hand. Gives the batter a pat as he walks off after a sensational knock
That's as clean as clean hitting gets! Tossed up full and wide and Head gives it a good whack over long-off. He really is back in form, isn't he?
Punched back to the bowler
On a length around leg, punched back to the bowler
Full and wide, driven down to long-off
Swatted away! On the shorter side and Kishan is so quick to bring out the pull through midwicket
Full around leg, blocked back to the bowler
He's early into the pull on this slower bouncer outside off. The ball deflects off the back of the bat to short third's left
Full-ish outside off, Kishan clips this out through the vacant midwicket region
Head backs away but Arora goes short outside off. Head has to hop and reach out but slaps it away over cover and it goes wide of long-off
Arora gets away with a full toss. This is low and going across Kishan, who hits a crisp drive through covers. But the fielder in the deep is able to cut it out
Back of length outside off, Head works this away to deep square leg
On a length around leg, punched down to long-on
And that's a 22-ball fifty up in style! In the slot and Head launches it over long-on and into the second tier!
On a length outside off, plays this in front of point
Slapped away to deep cover

Oh it bounces short of the fielder, and it bounces over Anukul Roy! Full on the stumps and Head slogs this over square leg. Bounces in front of Anukul, who is moving to his right, and spins to the left. Anukul can only get fingertips on it
Varun goes just a touch short and Kishan wants to pull him away. But it stays a tad low. Kishan hits it out to wide long-on
On a length outside off, blocked back towards the bowler
Full around off, Head looks to take it on but gets it off the toe end towards midwicket
Tucks this length ball into the vacant square leg region for a single
Deftly played! Uses the pace on the ball so well. 144kph length ball slanted across and he opens the face and finds the gap between short third and backward point
Welcome to the party, Ishan Kishan. Back of length ball sits up nicely outside leg and Kishan swivels and deposits this over backward square leg
Gets in a good yorker on the stumps, Kishan digs it back out over the bowler's head
Back of length ball slanted across him, Head backs away and slaps it to mid-off
Back of length outside off, Head pulls it off the inside half of the bat to deep square leg
And now some lucky runs, but they all count! Full on the stumps, Head looks to swing this away over midwicket but gets an inside edge through backward square leg
Bosh! Short and wide and Head is so quick to hammer his countryman over mid-off
Oh, what was that Travis Head? Just a bit of width on offer, Head backs away just a touch and then gets on only his left leg as he slaps it over mid-off
Full-ish outside off, steered through the vacant short third region
Length ball outside off, punched to point
On a length outside leg, tucked through square leg

Leading edge pops over the bowler! Kishan nearly fell first ball there. On a length around leg at 145kph. Kishan looks to tuck it leg side and gets a leadinng edge, but its gone back over the bowler and umpire

Tyagi gets rid of Abhishek! This is a back of length delivery around leg at 144kph. Abhishek looks to pull and is cramped for room and hurried by the pace. Gets it off the top edge and the ball balloons to midwicket's left for a simple catch
Full around leg, tucked through backward square
Head backs away and looks to slap away this short ball angled across. Called wide for height. KKR deliberate and decide against reviewing
Back of length around leg, Abhishek is cramped as he tries to pull. Scuffs it towards square leg
Sliced over short third! Short and wide, 141kph, angled across him. Abhishek slashes at it but gets it off the top edge. But he's hit it hard enough to clear the infield
On a length outside leg, Head backs away and thrashes a drive to cover
Narine overpitches again and Head cashes in by lofting him over mid-on. Deep midwicket was running to his right but had no chance there
Now Head gets Narine away! Googly outside leg, Head gets low and slogs this over square leg
Slapped away but straight to cover
Head backs away and looks to slap it down the ground. Hits it to mid-on
Full outside leg, clipped through square leg
Short again and punished! Arora is off to a poor start today. This is a bouncer outside off and Head pulls it away through square leg
Change in angle doesn't help the bowler! A touch short again and Head latches onto it instantly! Swings this away well wide of long-on
Slashed over cover point! Short and wide again from Arora and Head stands tall and cuts this high over point
Dug in short and going across Head, who unfurls a pull shot that he doesn't quite middle. Can't get it past midwicket
And now Head is in the action. Vaibhav goes short and gives Head just a hint of width. That's all that Head needs to whack it away through backward point, giving the fielder in the deep no chance
Full around off, eased out to deep point
On a length around leg, Abhishek works it down to long-off even as the ball hit higher on the bat than he'd have expected
Blocked towards cover

Abhishek has waited around enough! Sighters out of the way, he hits this one out of sight. It's a touch short from Narine and spinning away. Abhishek opens up his body and wallops this over cow corner
Full around off, driven wide of long-off. Just a single, though
On a length around middle, Abhishek knocks it down to long-off and gets a single to get SRH going
Full around middle and off, Abhishek watchfully plays it out to cover
four more, and KKR win!! Swatted to deep midwicket. Short delivery from Malinga, and Rinku thrashes it hard to seal the win
there's no long-on in place, and Rinku spots that. He backs away, and swings at this length delivery swinging in to arrive well outside leg. One more required by KKR
wide outside leg. This one swings into Rinku, and arrives fullish and wide of leg. He lets it go
short ball on leg, and ending on off. This doesn't get up a lot, and is pulled to deep square leg even as Rinku's bottom hand comes off the bat
three dots in a row. This is a bouncer. Sakib bangs it around middle, and the ball finishes around off. Rinku shaped to attack but let it go

quite full, and just outside leg. It's not called wide either. But Rinku reviews, and why not? Rinku is shown to have taken a step down leg before shifting to off again. Sakib went on a short of a length outside leg, and Rinku looked to clip but missed. Oh, the third umpire agrees with the on-field call. He says the ball would have met the batter had he been in his normal stance
bouncer at Rinku. This one angles across, and pitches around middle. Rinku sways out of the way
he leaps a little to try and get on top of this shortish ball, but it keeps low while seaming in. Clipped to fine leg

run-out chance missed... and it's four overthrows. Sakib bowled a shrotish ball which kept low on leg, and Rinku nudged it towards square leg. The batters took off, as the throw went to the non-striker's end. But there was no back-up and neither a direct hit, so the ball raced away to the boundary
on a length on middle and off, and turning away slightly. Pushed towards cover
tossed up, and it ends up being a low full toss on middle and leg. Driven wide of long-on

taken at long-off. In fact, the fielder was a good ten steps in. But is it too late for SRH? Shivang bowled the wrong 'un, as a fullish delivery turned away to finish on off. AR was into his attempted loft early, and the bottom hand came off the bat as the ball popped up towards long-off
ohh, this turns away from a length on off. Rinku cuts it late to point
bang!! He was sent early for exactly this. Shivang tosses it up, and bowls full on off. Rinku goes down to heave wide of long-on for six
angling across, and fullish on off. Cut away to deep point
another short balll... and it's not given wide. Rinku ducks under this ball pitching around sixth stump, so the over ends with a dot
another big short ball. This is slow on middle and leg, and is swung to fine leg

ohhh, this arrives ten sets of stumps outside leg. Cummins bangs it short on leg after he sees Rinku make room. The ball ends way wide as Rinku ducks, but Kishan still gets a hand as he dives to his right
another short delivery. This arrives just outside off, and he pulls to fine leg
slashed aerially to beat deep third to his left. Short ball on leg, and it finishes around off. But he leaps to ride the bounce, and sends it flying behind the wicket
he sways out of the way of this short delivery on the stumps, and guides it to deep third
ohh, he's struck on his chest. Cummins bowls short on leg, and in fact, AR is hit on his ribs as he looks to pull but misses. The ball dribbles to the leg side, and out comes the physio

got him!! A late twist coming? Simple catch for Smaran at square leg. Rahane is rushed by this pacy short ball climbing on to him. He goes for the pull from middle stump, but gets it off the top half of the bat. The ball seemed to have rushed on to him as Sakib switched back to the pace-on delivery
change of pace again. Short in length around sixth stump, and shaping in to finish much closer to off. Guided to deep third

wide outside off. AR looks to slash this short and wide ball, but misses. He had to reach out for it, but... Cummins reviews. The batter is unmoved, and the short ball is deemed to be well outside the wide line. But because AR was chasing it with the bat, the third umpire wants to check UltraEdge. Nope, there's no bat as the ball passes below the bat. So the wide call stands, and SRH lose a review
bouncer just outside off, and Ajinkya upper cuts to deep third
another one on the glove. Slow and short outside off, and finishing on leg. Ajinkya looks to pull but gets it down off the glove
slower ball, and Ajinkya is cramped for room. Sakib bowls on a short of a length around off, and gets it to finish on leg. Ajinkya ends up dabbing
short and wide outside off. Hacked hard to deep cover point
full and just outside off. Calmly pushed to long-on to raise fifty off 39 balls. When was the last time someone took that long to score fifty this season?!
Harshal goes wide of the crease, and bowls full and just outside off. Driven to long-off
four off the top edge. Short ball from Harshal, and this one rises outside off. Ajinkya looks to pull, but the ball flies over the keeper
Ajinkya backs away way out of leg. Harshal bowls short and wide of off, and the former is beaten on the attempted slash
slower bouncer. This arrives at AR on middle and off after pitching outside off, and he pulls to fine leg
bowls it short, and in the corridor outside off. Angkrish rides the bounce and slashes to point
tossed up, and it ends up being a low full toss wide of off. Driven to long-off
length delivery on middle and leg, and turning away. Punched to deep cover
well bowled. Little room for Rahane to try and cut that, as this ball is on a length on middle and off, and turning away. Rahane is beaten
full and flatter, and just outside off. Driven to long-off
beaten!! This time Angkrish goes after a googly which is full and wide. He looks to drive but misses, as the ball passes the outside edge
outside edge, but safe. He drives away from his body at this full ball angling across to arrive on off, but isn't in control
another short ball, this one at 139kph. AR swat-pulls it from in front of his head to fine leg
four more. This is nearly a yorker after a short ball. The ball tails in to arrive on leg, and AR clips it late to beat fine leg to his right

late change from AR, and it's four. The ball tickled Kishan's glove, though. Slower delivery from Malinga, who got the ball to climb well over middle and off. AR waited and waited, and upper cut belatedly
another dot ball. This delivery swings in, and is quite full on middle and off. Flicked to midwicket
short delivery this time. Malinga bowls this around fifth stump, and AR finds the man at midwicket as he pulls
slower ball, and on a length. It's wide of off, too, and AR slams it to cover
a short-arm pull to deep square leg. Cummins goes short on middle and leg, and the ball ends around off
quite full this time, and angling across to come around middle and off. Pushed to short midwicket
short ball again, and pulled from middle and leg to fine leg
short ball on leg, and angling across. Swatted to mid-on
on the bounce to the fine-leg fielder moving to his right. Short ball around off which seams in, and Rahane pulls aerially
bowls it on a fullish length on off, and AR taps it towards cover
On a length outside off, slapped away to deep point
Rahane looks to take on this short ball but miscues it. It balloons up but lands safely in the vacant midwicket region
Full outside off, rasping drive to cover, where the fielder puts in a good dive to deflect it to long-off
Full delivery, worked down to wide long-on
Sakib fires one down leg again
Slower ball, full outside off, tapped through point for a quick run
Starts with a wayward length ball that goes down leg. Kishan goes up in appeal, but they choose not to review
On a length on middle, punched down to long-off. 50-run stand up in 32 balls
On a length on off, cut away through point. They pick up two more
Full on leg, Raghuvanshi gets down and sweeps it hard through square leg
Full outside off, scooped out to deep point
Length ball angled across, cut away to deep point
Low full toss, Rahane skips out and lofts it to long-on on the bounce
Low full toss, punched down to long-on
Slower ball, full on off, Raghuvanshi nicely waits on it and clips it through backward square
Slower bouncer angled across him. Raghuvanshi even tried to get inside the line and swat it away bringing his bat from up to down, but can't connect. Called wide for height
Crunched hard past the diving backward point fielder! A tad too short and a tad too wide and Raghuvanshi picks the bones out of this slower ball with a hard-hit cut
Full outside off and angling into him, eased down to long-on
On a length outside off, Raghuvanshi glides it to deep third
Slower bouncer outside off, pulled away to deep square leg
Driven down to long-off for a single
On a length on leg and going across, punched to cover
Goes back to this length ball and punches it down to long-on
Floated full on off, knocked down to long-off
Oh, he beats short third racing to his left! Backs away to this short-ish ball and looks to cut. Gets a thick outside edge that goes fine on the off side and beats the fielder
Starts with a short-ish ball, Raghuvanshi pulls it to long-on
Low full toss sliding down leg, clipped to deep square leg
Now Malinga slides another full ball down leg. Raghuvanshi looked for another pick-up flick, but can't connect. But Malinga will have to bowl that one again
Raghuvanshi with another stunning pick-up shot! Length ball slanting into him and the youngster whips it behind square leg. Lovely wristwork
Slower ball in the blockhole, Rahane flicks it through midwicket
Full outside off, tucked to midwicket for a quick run
Full outside off, driven to mid-off
Oh, glorious from Raghuvanshi! Length ball sliding down leg and Raghuvanshi uses his wrists so well to hit a pick-up shot over backward square
Rahane picks the gap nicely there! Stays back to this length ball and drives this square and beats a diving point fielder
Full on middle, flicked square and he gets a single
On a length outside off, cut to backward point
Punched out to cover
Tossed up full, Raghuvanshi flicks it to midwicket
Floated full on leg, Rahane works it wide of mid-on

And, Finn's fun is over. Not a ball you want to get out to, full and sliding down leg. Allen looks to whip it leg side, but it goes off the toe end and straight to deep midwicket. Klaasen doesn't drop those!
Put away in the gap! Short ball doesn't quite rise enough but Allen pulls it away along the ground and pierces the gap between deep square leg and deep midwicket

Allen in full flow now! This is the Finn Allen KKR fans were looking forward to! Cummins serves up a slot ball outside off and Allen just clears his front leg and creams this over mid-off. Bounces just short of the boundary rope
Crunnnchhed over square leg! Back of length, 140kph cross-seam delivery and Allen stands tall and nails the pull
Works this through midwicket for a couple
Clears the fielder! Length ball sits up nicely and Allen hammers this in front of square. Deep square leg runs to his left but it's got enough height on it
Cummins goes full and wide and Allen looked to reverse-ramp it, but can't reach it. Beats Kishan and KKR get the boundary they wanted

Looks for the slower yorker and Rahane backs away and uses the open face to steer it through the gap at point. Not enough pace on the ball for it to race away to the ropes though as the fielders catch up
On a length around off, punched to cover
Full outside off, Rahane looks to work it leg side and gets it to midwicket
A bad ball, and it's put away by Rahane. Malinga goes too full and strays down leg side. Rahane clicks it away over backward square for a six
Full outside off, 142kph, driven to mid-off
Full outside off, blocked back to the bowler
And finally Allen connects! 140kph back of length delivery angles into him. Allen pulls it away over square leg rather nonchalantly. Deep square leg was scurrying across, but can't get there

Now a swish and a miss. The stadium erupts as Kishan goes up in appeal. Cummins not sure there was a nick. Back of length delivery outside off. Allen backs away and tries to punch it on the off side but is beaten. Replay confirms there was no nick
Full outside off, punched to mid-off
Back of length around off, punched in front of cover, but the fielder is quick to cut out the single
Back of length outside off, tucked through square leg
Length ball on the pads, Allen knocks it down to long-on
Allen whips this length ball out to deep midwicket
Works this tlength ball wide of mid-on and he gets a single despite a fumble by the fielder
Tossed full outside off, punched to the bowler's left
Length ball sliding down leg, tucked towards deep midwicket
Knocks this full ball on off towards long-off
And Rahane is off the mark with a boundary. Easy pickings for him as Abhishek lobs up a low full toss going down leg. Rahane uses his wrists to whip it in the gap between midwicket and mid-on
